         ARUM DRACONTIUM

       Green Dragon


A remedy for Pharyngitis with sore, raw and tender throat.



Head.--  Heavy; shooting pain in ears, aching pain behind right
      ear.



Throat.--  Dry, sore, worse swallowing. Raw and tender. Continued
      disposition to clear throat. Croupy, hoarse cough with sore throat.



Urinary.--  Irresistible desire to pass urine, burns and smarts.



Respiratory.--  Hoarseness; excess of mucus in larynx. Asthmatic
      at night. Expectoration thick, heavy.



Relationship.--    Arum Italicum
      (Brain-fag, with headache in occipital region).   Arum maculatum
      (inflammation and ulceration of mucous membranes. Nasal irritation with polypus).



Dose.--  First potency.
